It also names the Helm value `bpf.enableTCX` as the switch for keeping the old-style attachment (`bpf.enableTCX=false`), so helm-value path bpf.enableTCX is the right subject. The values validator confirms that this key exists only in the target chart [ev-28e0ccb5774a, ev-39a22d88e2f5]. Because the key did not exist before, there is no earlier default to compare against, so default-changed does not fit. The upstream change is that an unchanged setup now behaves differently, so behavior-changed is the right change type.
